## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Unit tests pass
- [ ] Lint passes
- [ ] Format check passes
- [ ] tests/scripts/test-loop-touchpoint-sprint-verifier-fail.sh exists and is executable
- [ ] grep -q 'Current cycle: N of MAX_CYCLES' plugins/dso/skills/sprint/SKILL.md
- [ ] grep -q 'See:.*protocol' plugins/dso/skills/sprint/SKILL.md
- [ ] grep -q 'escalation_upstream' plugins/dso/skills/sprint/SKILL.md (dynamic upstream source)
- [ ] dd-2 fixture asserts REPLAN_ESCALATE upstream changes per synthetic escalation_upstream
- [ ] bash tests/scripts/test-loop-touchpoint-sprint-verifier-fail.sh → PASS
- [ ] bash tests/scripts/test-loop-touchpoint-preplanning-phase-e.sh → PASS (non-regression)
- [ ] bash tests/scripts/test-loop-touchpoint-implplan-steps.sh → PASS (non-regression)
